thread:
anya: Quick sync — handover plan for zeta-13B weights + tokenizer. HF origin path is `rgx/hf-org/zeta-13b-v2`. We'd like to mirror to `s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/13b/v2`. Who's owning presign links and checksum validation for the initial copy?

kevin: I can own presign flow. Ops will need to create the signed URLs from the mirror job. For checksum, do we want SHA256 on the tarball + per-file digests in manifest?

ops-sasha: @kevin that works. Recommend both: tarball SHA256 for atomicity, and per-file sha256/size in the manifest for integrity checks during streaming loads. Also, bucket policy: the mirror role (arn:aws:iam::123456:role/hf-mirror) needs s3:GetObject + s3:PutObject + s3:PutObjectAcl on the target prefix.

ryan: quick tokenizer note — this model's tokenizer has a nonstandard BPE merges file naming: `merges.v3` (not `merges.txt`). The loader in runtime expects `.txt` by default; we'll need a small compatibility shim or rename during ingestion. Also there's an extra `special_tokens_map.json` missing from HF metadata historically.

anya: Good catch. For the shim, can we do a simple copy step in the mirror job? rename merges.v3 -> merges.txt and add special_tokens_map.json (we have a template).

kevin: yep, mirror job can run a pre-upload transform container. Example sketch: 
```bash
# download origin
aws s3 cp s3://hf-org-models/zeta-13b-v2/model.tar.gz /tmp/
# unpack + rename
tar -xzf model.tar.gz -C /tmp/model && mv /tmp/model/merges.v3 /tmp/model/merges.txt
# insert template tokens if missing
[ -f /tmp/model/special_tokens_map.json ] || cp /opt/templates/special_tokens_map.json /tmp/model/
# repack and push
tar -czf /tmp/model-fixed.tar.gz -C /tmp/model .
aws s3 cp /tmp/model-fixed.tar.gz s3://redwood-artifacts/zeta/13b/v2/model-fixed.tar.gz
```

maria: For checksum calc, use `sha256sum` on the rebuilt tarball and also generate a `manifest.jsonl` with per-file sha256/size. Our ingestion path reads manifest.jsonl to validate and populate the registry. Example manifest line: \{"path\":\"model/merges.txt\",\"sha256\":\"<hex>\",\"size\":12345\}

ryan: Minor note: if you change file names, make sure the model-card references are updated or we keep a `source_manifest.json` mapping original names so model onboarding traces back to HF.\
ops-sasha: TTL on presigned URLs — let's keep them short for security but long enough for mirror jobs. Suggest 24h for upload, 1h for downloads by ingestion. Also: we need to tag the S3 objects with `origin=hf` and `origin_commit=<sha>` so we can track provenance.

kevin: Agreed on tags. I'll add a CI check that the mirror job writes tags and a `provenance.txt` with the HF commit id. One more: permission for registry-readers group to read the final objects — put a bucket prefix ACL or use a read-only IAM role `redwood-registry-reader`.

anya: Who will do the registry-side validation (schema + tokenizer sanity) once mirror complete? I can take schema checks (manifest shape). @ryan can you run tokenizer smoke tests (encode/decode 50 sample inputs + compare token counts)?

ryan: Yup, I'll run tokenizer smoke test. Quick checklist for me to run after mirror job finishes: 1) check merges.txt exists, 2) load vocab.json, 3) run `encode("Hello world")` and ensure consistent roundtrip with decode for 50 sentences, 4) check special tokens present.

maria: For the registry, I'll enforce these validations in a gating job that marks the artifact as `ready_for_serving` only if all checks pass. If any fail, job emits structured error log like `TOKENIZER_MISSING_MERGES` or `CHECKSUM_MISMATCH`.

deploy-bot: Mirror job scheduled: mirror-zeta-13b-v2 -> starts 2026-03-18T09:30:00Z. Presign owner: kevin. Notifying @anya @ryan @maria on completion. :rocket:

anya: Thanks. Please drop presign URL and manifest link in thread when done. If anything blocks IAM or k8s job quotas ping infra on #eng-infra.

kevin: I'll follow up with a short PR to the mirror job config with the rename step and tags. Expecting to push by EOD PST.

ops-sasha: I'll pre-provision the mirror role and attach the policy. Leaving a checklist here: [x] IAM role created, [ ] CI PR for rename, [ ] provenance tagging, [ ] manifest schema check, [ ] tokenizer smoke run, [ ] registry gate pass.

anya: awesome — thanks team.

kevin: one last thing — checksum algorithm: we use lowercase hex sha256, no prefix. Example: `e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855`. Please ensure tools don't include `SHA256()` wrappers in outputs.

maria: noted. I'll make the registry parser tolerant to both raw hex and `sha256:hex` but gate will only accept the raw hex for final pass.

ryan: will post tokenizer smoke logs and sample tokenization diffs into the thread once complete.

anya: great. If anyone hits HF rate limits during download, tag me and we'll throttle or ask for a signed bulk export. :pray:
